requirements.statement: Every path, name and pattern text emitted into SBPL MUST pass through the one quoting function or be passed as a named parameter; the function MUST escape backslash and quote and MUST refuse NUL, control characters and invalid UTF-8 with a typed error, and every accepted value MUST decode back to the exact input.

acceptance.given: a subtree named /tmp/a"b\c(d)
acceptance.then: the profile holds one subtree rule whose quoted string decodes to exactly those bytes and adds no other syntax
acceptance.when: the policy is lowered for macOS

acceptance.given: a path containing a newline or a non-UTF-8 byte
acceptance.then: lowering fails with a typed error and the path is not altered or dropped

acceptance.given: at least 10,000 generated byte strings and the fuzz corpus
acceptance.then: each result either decodes to its input or is refused

tasks.text: [P] Implement `Glob` in `P/src/glob.rs`. It is absolute UTF-8 with no control characters. Tokens `*`, `**` (whole component only), `?`, `\x`; `[ ] { }` unescaped are refused.
